Components / Reasoning

Plan

The agent's plan: a card + collapsible shell whose steps are the TASK organism's own rows — composed by the consumer, never a fork of task's internals. Title and description shimmer while streaming, at web parity, on the Shimmer organism's house pulse; the footer badge keeps the remaining count glanceable even collapsed. defaultOpen stays true — a plan is the overview the user asked for, unlike task's phone-density collapse.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/plan.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/plan.json

Theming

Themed via text-muted-foreground, border-border, text-foreground.

Usage

(o) => ( <Plan defaultOpen={o.defaultOpen !== false} isStreaming={o.isStreaming === true}> <PlanHeader> <PlanTitle>Ship the v0.2.0 registry</PlanTitle> <PlanDescription>Four steps, all verified against the real CLI</PlanDescription> <PlanProgressBadge steps={[{ status: 'completed' }, { status: 'completed' }, { status: 'in_progress' }, { status: 'pending' }]} /> </PlanHeader> <PlanContent> <TaskItem status="completed"> <Text className="text-sm text-foreground">Fix the six dependency declarations</Text> </TaskItem> <TaskItem status="completed"> <Text className="text-sm text-foreground">Regenerate both engine trees</Text> </TaskItem> <TaskItem status="in_progress"> <Text className="text-sm text-foreground">Install the full set into apps/example</Text> </TaskItem> <TaskItem status="pending"> <Text className="text-sm text-foreground">Cut and push the release tag</Text> </TaskItem> </PlanContent> </Plan> )

The TextClassContext seam

This component publishes its class strings through the TextClassContext provider, so a parent view can restyle its nested text.
